subject.name: Individuals & Societies
subject.programme: IB MYP 3 Individuals & Societies (integrated humanities; History / Geography options)
subject.examPattern: MYP 3: no external exam – school-designed summative tasks assessed on criteria A–D (each 0–8, total /32 → grade 1–7); every criterion assessed ≥2× per year. Mock papers here mirror the MYP 5 eAssessment format so students practise it early. Mock: 3-task paper in MYP 5 I&S eAssessment style (~15 items).
